corrections.reason: The Amharic gloss for Ge'ez 'ተለዓለ' (he was lifted up / ascended) is 'ከፍ ፡ አለ' (he rose high), where the left stroke of 'ከ' was misread as 'አ'.
Parallel to line 15, the commentary on 'ወነሥአቶ ፡ ደመና' reads 'ደመና ፡ ከፍ ፡ አደረገችው' (the cloud lifted him up high); 'ከ' was misread as 'አ' due to ink bleed.
